messages:
emma-partnerops: Partner 'AtlasWare' filed an urgent ticket: large reseller invoices show usage attributed to the wrong distributor. They include sample webhook rows where 'warehouse_code' and 'site_id' appear swapped.
kevin-revops: saw the anomaly on the reseller ledger. Our current entitlement matcher uses partner_provided_site_id and falls back to warehouse_code if missing. Looks like their SI started populating warehouse_code with the distributor id.
raj-plateng: can you paste one sanitized example?
emma-partnerops: snippet below (redacted):
```
{customer: 'atlas-88', event_ts: '2026-03-22T11:05:12Z', warehouse_code: 'DISTR-33', site_id: 'WH-77', sku: 'aws-edge', units: 10}
{customer: 'atlas-88', event_ts: '2026-03-22T11:06:00Z', warehouse_code: 'WH-77', site_id: 'DISTR-33', sku: 'aws-edge', units: 5}
```
sophie-sales: oh no. reseller billing splits by distributor id, so swapping these flips revenue. Partner is asking whether we'll reverse invoices.
kai-ops: ledger-bridge currently indexes entitlement by (partner_id, site_id, distributor_id) where nulls fallback to warehouse_code. This kind of swap breaks deterministic lookup.
kevin-revops: short-term mitigation: create an ingest validation rule that detects when warehouse_code and site_id values match known distributor patterns (e.g., prefix DISTR-) and when the two fields are mutually inconsistent across events from the same device_id within a 1h window. If detected, tag events as 'probable-field-swap' and hold >0 units for 72h pending partner mapping confirmation. Show them in recon CSV.
raj-plateng: agree. Add a fingerprint computed as sha256(partner_id + device_id + event_date + sku) so swapped-field duplicates map to same fingerprint and won't double-bill. Also add ingest.normalized_site = canonicalize(site_id, warehouse_code, mapping_table).
emma-partnerops: partner-facing plan: we'll run a targeted backfill to correct the last billing cycle, but only after partner uploads a signed mapping file that states which values are distributor ids vs warehouse ids. We need legal sign-off for invoice adjustments.
sophie-sales: i'll coordinate the invoice hold and sales approval. Also propose offering a one-time credit and manual reconciliation for top-10 resellers to avoid churn.
kai-ops: portal change: add a "warehouse/distributor mapping" upload in partner settings that accepts CSV with columns: reported_value, canonical_type (distributor|warehouse|site), canonical_id, effective_from_ts, checksum. When uploaded, system auto-applies mapping and clears holds for matched rows.
kevin-revops: operational rules: 1) hold flagged events in ledger with hold_reason='field_swap_probable' and hold_expiry = event_ts + 72h 2) expose endpoint /v1/partner/held-events to let partners claim rows with evidence 3) run nightly reconcile job to auto-apply mapping if partner file present.
partnerbot: webhook delivered 200 OK to /marketplace/webhook (atlasware). signature verified.
raj-plateng: owners: raj -> ingest detection + fingerprinting (owner) by EOD tomorrow; kevin -> ledger hold + held-events API by Fri; emma -> partner contract+ticket template & coordinate legal + invoice holds by Wed; kai -> portal mapping upload by next Tue; sophie -> sales credits approval and comms by Wed.
kevin-revops: measuring: track number of held rows, percent of affected invoices, time-to-clear holds, adjustments applied. set alert if held rows > 0.5% of partner daily volume.
emma-partnerops: once owners confirm, i'll schedule a joint call with AtlasWare + their SI to share the preview backfill and mapping CSV format. thanks team. :thumbsup:
thread_text_snippet: AtlasWare reseller invoices misattributed due to warehouse_code/site_id swap; plan: detect probable-field-swap, hold >0 units 72h, fingerprinting, partner mapping CSV upload and backfill
